summary: Death penalty upheld for rape and murder of 10-year-old girl under POCSO; circumstantial evidence validated as 'rarest of rare'; lack of DNA evidence addressed through medical examination omission rebuttal; last-seen doctrine applied; trial fairness and juvenile separation procedural compliance confirmed; High Court's confirmation of death sentence affirmed.

Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.366, s.367, s.368, s.209, s.53A

Rajendra Prahladrao Wasnik v State of Maharashtra (2019) 12 SCC 495
